source.prompt:
Create one combination logo for Logo Land. Industry: Conversational logo and app icon creation plugin for Codex. Audience: Independent builders and small teams turning an idea into a clear visual identity.
Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'LOGO LAND'. Exact slogan: ''.
Styles: minimal, geometric, warm, refined. Original brief palette context: Charcoal #252722 for the frame and lettering, Ivory #F6F3EC for the complete opaque canvas, Muted terracotta #B75E45 as one restrained optional mark accent.
Avoid: gradients, shadows, mockups, extra lettering, generic AI sparkles, complex decorative detail. Use cases: README hero at 320 and 240 CSS pixels wide, plugin identity.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: A distinctive open drawing frame with generous negative space: a thick charcoal almost-square contour, intentionally open at the upper-right corner, and one small restrained warm geometric piece aligned with that opening, suggesting an idea taking its final shape. Pair this simple symbol at the left with LOGO LAND on one line. Refined yet approachable, clean flat geometry and confident legible letterforms. Compose one wide master canvas approximately 1536 by 768 pixels, opaque ivory edge to edge. Let the complete horizontal lockup occupy about 80 percent of the width with calm clear margins; the mark and wordmark must remain clear when the entire image is displayed at 320 and 240 CSS pixels wide. No extra words, slogans, decorative scenery, or alternate concepts.. Assumptions: User delegated one original master concept, color selection and application, An open drawing frame suggests an idea becoming a finished symbol, Wide opaque master is the requested deliverable; no transparent variant requested, Colors are advisory suggestions, with no locked/required/allowed HEX or maximum count.

warnings: Advisory color evidence: pass; no strict constraints apply.

color_method: sRGB to Lab D50; CIEDE2000, ColorAide method=2000
color_limits: Sampled raster evidence, not an exact-pixel, Pantone, or print-proof guarantee.
At most 16384 original-coordinate samples; small accents may be missed.
Alpha-zero pixels are excluded; conformance uses alpha >=250 and preserves white.
Strict evidence needs 128 core samples and at most 10% partial-alpha visible samples.
Restricted fit requires 99% core coverage within delta-E00 <=5; design colors need 1% share.
Locks/required colors need 32 matching core samples and 0.5% core share.
Quantized measured swatches are estimates; conformance uses original sampled colors.
Color roles, lettering, and placement require visual review; histograms cannot prove them.
ROI evidence covers only the stated region; opaque full-image evidence includes background.
Contrast ratios on explicit composited surfaces are guidance, not logo AA certification.
